items.question: What's the minimum recommended ad budget?
items.answer: Depends on industry and goals. Generally we recommend at least €1,500/month media + agency fee so algorithms exit the learning phase. Below that we focus on offer, site and tracking first.

items.question: How fast do results show?
items.answer: First signals within 48–72h after launch. Real optimization is visible in 2–4 weeks, once we have enough data to make decisions.

about.subHeadline: I'm Laurentiu, founder of Green Pheonix Concept. I work at the intersection of data, design and execution — no jargon, no fluff, just measurable results.

section1.title: Why Green Pheonix exists
section1.p1: I have worked in marketing since 2024. I started as a Marketing Specialist at The Family Butchers România, running Meta campaigns for two national FMCG brands — Reinert and Martinel. In that time I gained hands-on experience across more than 1.1 million impressions and 700,000 people reached through multi-platform campaigns.
section1.p2: But I also saw what doesn't work in this industry. Agencies selling buzzwords. Flashy websites that don't sell. Beautiful ads made by agencies that don't perform because Meta's algorithms flag them as “advertising” and penalize them. Clients treated as IDs in a dashboard.
section1.p3: Green Pheonix grew out of one conviction: performance marketing should be done differently. We think before we act, we measure before we optimize, and we're honest with clients — even when they don't want to hear it.

section2.title: The four things I fundamentally believe

belief1.title: Simplicity that sells > decorative complexity
belief1.body: A beautiful site that doesn't sell is just an expensive suit. I build sites that are clear, fast, with a single path to action. Design isn't a creative award — it's a mechanism for trust and conversion. The most effective sites I've built are also the simplest.

belief2.title: Ads alone don't sell
belief2.body: A good ad moves traffic. Your organic profile decides whether they buy. Before the first campaign, I look at what a user finds when they reach you: is the social profile active? Are there real reviews? Is the content authentic or does it look like stock? The organic foundation is the investment that multiplies the ROI of every ad that follows.

belief3.title: Authenticity matters to clients and to algorithms
belief3.body: In 2026, ads that look like ads die. Meta rolled out Andromeda — an ML system that favors creative that looks REAL: UGC, natural lifestyle, people talking about a product instead of “selling” it. One person who steps in front of the camera and builds a connection with the brand is worth more than 10 glossy agency videos. For consumers and for algorithms alike.

belief4.title: Strategy before execution
belief4.body: Good campaigns are thought through, not improvised. Before the first ad: who is the ideal client, what message resonates, what objection needs dismantling, what path they take from click to purchase. That's the difference between an “agency that pushes buttons” and an “agency that produces results”. I turn down contracts where the client wants to skip strategy. Not because I can't — because I've seen too many campaigns burned on sloppy execution.

section3.title: How I work
section3.p1: You work directly with me. There's no intermediary account manager handing you off to a developer. You talk to me — I execute.
section3.p2: I work with a small number of clients, not a portfolio of 30. I'd rather have 4-6 serious clients handled with care than 30 handled superficially.
section3.p3: We communicate on your preferred channel — Slack, WhatsApp, email. I reply within 24 working hours. For real emergencies (a campaign down, a site crashed), I reply faster.
section3.p4: I work in three languages: Romanian, Italian, English. That opens up opportunities for clients who want to reach the Romanian diaspora in Italy or the UK.
